## Send a Message

You can reach out directly by email or via the [NMBU staff page](https://www.nmbu.no/en/user/36818).

For **student inquiries** (Master's or PhD supervision), please include a brief description of your research interest and a CV.

For **collaboration inquiries**, please include your institutional affiliation and the topic you'd like to discuss.
